label: rem:archimedean-functor-uniqueness-context
title: Pre-archimedean separation, corollaries, and open problems for the archimedean functor uniqueness
html:
The two classes taken as [Instance] hypotheses by the Lean theorem QOU.Archimedean.archimedean_functor_uniqueness are the only unproved inputs; both are well-established results awaiting Mathlib formalisation (Real.dilog, BlochGroup, the Suslin map).

Pre-archimedean / archimedean separation

The QOU substrate is pre-archimedean: every block in the motivic substrate and the algebraic quantum volume lives in R = \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1/2}, (q-q^{-1})^{-1}], a ring of Laurent polynomials with no real-analytic transcendentals. QOU observables — masses, binding energies, the fine-structure constant — are real numbers, and the only exit from R to \mathbb{R} is the archimedean realization functor \tau_{\text{arch}}.

Two structural questions are settled simultaneously by Bloch-Suslin pentagon-uniqueness. (i) Uniqueness of the exit: any real-valued continuous functional on B(\mathbb{C}) respecting the 5-term pentagon identity is forced to coincide with D up to a single overall scalar; therefore the archimedean image of a substrate motivic class is canonical. (ii) Provenance of \pi: any transcendental constant in a QOU observable is the \tau_{\text{arch}}-image of substrate pentagon data via D (or its multivariate generalisations), and is therefore not an external import. The additive Bring zero-mode candidate prop:em-coupling-bring-zero-mode illustrates the second point: the 2/(3\pi) = 2g/(4\pi(g-1)) correction at g = 4 is the archimedean shadow of pentagon data on Bring's surface, not a \pi-import outside R.

The algebraic / archimedean dichotomy establishes a clean separation between categorical structure and continuum measurement. The mass formula evaluates a closed cycle on the Frobenius-Hopf substrate. The non-degenerate Frobenius pairing \int_A \circ \mu identifies A \cong A^\vee, making the substrate algebra self-dual. This self-duality drives the descent involution \hat{\tau}_n on the endomorphism algebra, which splits the categorical mass endomorphism into a descended baseline component and a transient component localized at the exceptional divisors of the brane tower.

Within this purely algebraic substrate, the mass evaluation yields the algebraic quantum volume:

  \mathrm{Vol}_q(\beta) \;=\; \prod_{i=0}^{A-2}\hat{V}_i(q),
  \qquad \hat{V}_i(q) \in \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1/2}],

a finite product of Laurent polynomials living strictly in \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1/2}]. This domain is categorical and discrete: devoid of \pi, \zeta(3), or real-analytic transcendentals.

Transcendental numbers enter the framework exclusively at the boundary of observation. The functor \tau_{\text{arch}} projects categorical data into physical spacetime by taking the absolute logarithm of the algebraic quantum volume. This functor converts the discrete Hecke algebra states into continuous observables.

To satisfy the Descartes condition \chi = -6, the physical state space restricts to Bring's surface, a genus-4 curve with maximal S_5 automorphism. The observable particle spectrum consists entirely of knots that embed within this genus-4 handlebody. After applying \tau_{\text{arch}}, the Kashaev volume conjecture identifies the limit of the algebraic state sum with the classical hyperbolic volume of these specific knot complements. In this limit, the quantum dilogarithm \Phi_q(z_i) evaluated at each exceptional divisor degenerates into the Bloch-Wigner dilogarithm D(z_i). The Bloch-Wigner dilogarithm is uniquely characterized as the function satisfying the 5-term pentagon identity, providing the exact geometric measure of the ideal tetrahedra that triangulate the knot complement.

Corollaries

(a) Resolves the pre-archimedean concern in prop:em-coupling-bring-zero-mode. The \pi in the additive correction 2/(3\pi) = 2g/(4\pi(g-1)) at g=4 is the unique archimedean shadow of pentagon-coherent substrate data on Bring's surface. The substrate's pentagon coherence forces the archimedean image to involve D (and hence \pi via D's functional equation); no other transcendental shape is admissible. The additive correction is therefore not outside R — it is the canonical \tau_{\text{arch}}-image of R-internal pentagon data.

(b) Forecloses arbitrary \pi-imports. Any candidate closed form for a QOU observable that includes a transcendental constant not derivable from D (or its multivariate generalisations D_n) is excluded. This is a falsifiability constraint: the multiplicative gluon-octet form (a legacy PSLQ-empirical conjecture, since superseded by prop:em-coupling-bring-zero-mode) required arbitrary integer ratios 45 \cdot [3]_q \cdot (1+\delta_{CS}+8q\delta_{CS}^2) that would have to come from a non-pentagon source, is ruled out structurally in addition to the existing PSLQ ruling.

(c) Pins the figure-8 knot example. The figure-8 knot 4_1 embeds smoothly into Bring's surface as the amphichiral mass mechanism. On the pre-archimedean side it has a rigorous motivic / algebraic representation via its Hecke normal form in \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1/2}]. Once \tau_{\text{arch}} maps this motivic state into the observable continuum, its hyperbolic volume realizes as the transcendental \mathrm{Vol}(4_1) = 2\,\mathrm{Cl}_2(\pi/3) \approx 2.02988. The motivic side guarantees exact algebraic relationships governing particle interactions; \tau_{\text{arch}} supplies the transcendental continuum required for geometric measurement. See figure-8 archimedean illustration.

Open problems

  1. K-theoretic identification. Make the Bloch-group factoring of the QOU mass-formula state sum precise: which class in K_3^{\text{ind}}(\mathbb{C}) does an A-strand braid \beta represent? Conjecturally, the class is read off from the Yekutieli triple data; making this rigorous requires identifying the J^2-jet of the cosimplicial structure with a Bloch-group 1-cocycle.
  2. Multivariate Bloch-Suslin. For mass-tower contributions spanning multiple exceptional divisors, the relevant invariant is the higher Bloch group B_n(\mathbb{C}) with the n-variable polylogarithm D_n. Pentagon-uniqueness for D_n at n \geq 3 is open in the literature (Goncharov 1995 conjectures); the QOU framework can take it as input where needed.
  3. Lean formalisation of Suslin1991. Mathlib has neither Real.dilog nor BlochGroup. The Lean stub records this as a sorry keyed to [suslin1991]; closure depends on upstream Mathlib work.

Witness

No canonical witness is appropriate for a uniqueness claim. The relevant cross-check is that any new closed form for a QOU observable proposed in this repository must be expressible as a \tau_{\text{arch}}-image of a pentagon-coherent R-internal class, or equivalently, must factor through D (or D_n) in its archimedean expansion. The em-coupling-bring-zero-mode candidate satisfies this; the legacy gluon-octet PSLQ candidate (now removed; superseded by prop:em-coupling-bring-zero-mode) did not.
